name: Call Agent
description: Send a message to another agent and get its response. Useful for delegating specialized tasks.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to call (see Available Agents in your instructions)

message.description: The message to send to the agent

attachment_indices.description: Optional 0-based indices of the current user's attachments to forward to the agent, e.g. [0]. See the 'Attachments (this turn)' list in your instructions. Omit when no attachment is relevant.
